summary: Iter38 — Section 34.5 Streak reminder fan-out (daily 7pm habit loop). Backend pytest 17/17 PASS on new test_iter38_streak_reminders.py covering: GET/POST /providers/me/streak/preferences (provider-default false, idempotent toggle, 403 non-provider, 401 unauth), POST /admin/streaks/send-reminders (403 non-admin, 401 unauth, scan shape {ok,queued,skipped,scanned}, at_risk user gets queued with in-app notification category='streaks'+priority='high'+title '🔥 Tu racha de 4 días está por expirar'+cta_url=/dashboard/provider#streak+notification_key='{uid}::streak_reminder::{date}', SMS+email queue rows with trigger_type='streak_reminder_4d', idempotency on 2nd call no duplicate in-app, opt_out=true user skipped, current_days<3 skipped), /api/notifications surfaces category='streaks' in merge, demo seed integrity check (María still alive current>=5). Regression iter37 = 14/14 PASS after 60s sleep. Frontend Playwright: StreakWidget pref toggle initial='Recuérdame'(Bell), click→'Silenciado'(BellOff)+toast 'Recordatorios silenciados', click again→'Recuérdame'+toast 'Recordatorios activados'. Widget renders María's 5-day alive streak with progress to 7-day milestone. Test isolation used synthetic TEST_* provider with manually inserted streaks doc (current=4, last_active=yesterday) — full cleanup at module teardown; demo provider's seed untouched.

minor.issue: Pre-existing rate-limit (5/60s) requires 60s sleep between full regression suites (same issue documented since iter35). Worked around in test runner.

critical_code_review_comments: _enqueue_streak_reminder_for correctly enforces all three skip rules: (a) status not in (at_risk, alive) OR days<3 → skip, (b) status=alive AND last_active=today → skip (user already won today), (c) user.streak_reminders_opt_out=true → skip. All three verified by separate tests.
Idempotency via notification_key='{uid}::streak_reminder::{today_utc_iso}' is implemented via find_one check before insert. Verified by running fan-out twice and asserting count_documents unchanged.

Admin scan correctly pre-filters at the DB layer with {current_days: {$gte: 3}} on db.streaks, then re-computes via _compute_streak per user (refreshes status/last_active before the queue decision). Good defensive pattern — handles stale streaks rows where the actual sessions/messages have since lapsed.

_compute_streak persists current_days/last_active_date on EVERY call (even when current<=best), so the streaks doc never falls out of sync with reality. This means the admin scan's $gte:3 filter would correctly drop a user whose actual current_days dropped below 3 since the last cron run.
audit_log fires with payload {queued, skipped, scanned} on every admin fan-out — correct accountability trail.

MINOR: _enqueue_streak_reminder_for fetches user via db.users.find_one with projection that excludes _id but doesn't normalize streak_reminders_opt_out. Default behavior when field absent treats it as falsy (correct). No bug, just observation.

MINOR: Hours-remaining calc `24 - datetime.now(timezone.utc).hour` is naive — at 23:30 UTC it'll say '1h' but cron firing at any other hour means it's not 'truly' 7pm local. Acceptable for v1 since the cron schedule is global UTC-driven; locale-aware 7pm fan-out is a future enhancement (would need timezone per user).
MINOR: Frontend togglePref optimistically updates state AFTER successful POST, not before. Safe but slight UX delay on slow networks. Spinner via savingPref disables button — acceptable.
Frontend StreakWidget correctly fetches /streak and /streak/preferences in parallel via Promise.all, single render after both resolve. Good perf.
Notification merge endpoint /api/notifications correctly includes 'streaks' in the $in array alongside 'gigs' and 'referrals' (line 4318) so streak nudges show in the bell icon.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (StreakWidget pref toggle Recuérdame↔Silenciado + both toasts confirmed; widget hierarchy and 5-day streak rendering verified)

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. One test setup pitfall discovered & fixed during authoring: _collect_activity_dates pulls dates from `created_at` not `activity_date`, so synthetic seed sessions must be stamped with real datetimes ON each target calendar day, not today's `now.isoformat()`. Fix was a 4-line change in the fixture — already committed in test_iter38_streak_reminders.py.
